not_like_the_others: companion-server-contract and wizard-label-token record DECISIONS. This one records DEBT. Do not copy its shape to excuse a defect.
ratchet: This list may only SHRINK, and the counts must stay exact. A file with unbounded tables that is not listed FAILS the gate. A listed file that became clean FAILS until its entry is deleted. A count that grew FAILS. A count that shrank also FAILS, until it is corrected -- a baseline that over-states the debt makes 'no regressions' easier to pass. An entry with no note FAILS.
summary: Tables that render a collection with no bound anywhere -- not a pager in the template, and no slice, Paginator or paginate_by in the scope that renders it. Every entry is a real defect that nobody has fixed yet.
why_this_exists: Before this the gate had ZERO runners, so an unbounded table could land with nothing noticing. These were invisible because the gate accepted data-rmc-scroll-policy="paginate" as a bound; that attribute drives a long-page SECTION navigator and never removes a row, so 77 tables were excused by it. Teaching the gate to find the bound in the VIEW cleared 40 of them as genuinely capped. These are the remainder.
